description: Source code for the LSM6DSL sensor driver, implementing accelerometer, gyroscope, and temperature sensor functionalities, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and power management.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the LSM6DSL device by setting the boot bit and waiting for sensor turn-on time.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer full-scale raw value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer output data rate raw value and updates internal frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the gyroscope full-scale raw value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the gyroscope output data rate raw value and updates internal frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_odr_set
methods.description: Configures accelerometer ODR based on frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_range_set
methods.description: Configures accelerometer range and updates sensitivity.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_config
methods.description: Configures accelerometer attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_odr_set
methods.description: Configures gyroscope ODR based on frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_range_set
methods.description: Configures gyroscope range and updates sensitivity.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_config
methods.description: Configures gyroscope attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes for accelerometer and gyroscope.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch_accel
methods.description: Fetches accelerometer sample data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch_gyro
methods.description: Fetches gyroscope sample data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch_temp
methods.description: Fetches temperature sample data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch_magn
methods.description: Fetches magnetometer data from external chip.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch_press
methods.description: Fetches pressure data from external chip.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves accelerometer channel data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_accel_channel_get
methods.description: Gets specific accelerometer channel data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_convert
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves gyroscope channel data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_channel_get
methods.description: Gets specific gyroscope channel data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gyro_channel_get_temp
methods.description: Gets temperature data from gyroscope temp sample.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_magn_convert
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_magn_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves magnetometer channel data.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_magn_channel_get
methods.description: Gets specific magnetometer channel data.

methods.name: lps22hb_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value.

methods.name: lps22hb_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves data for specified sensor channel.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, sets default configurations, and verifies chip ID.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, including bus and chip setup, and optional trigger and external chip initialization.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions (suspend/resume) for the device.
